reason: I'd play with the free tricks to show off at the next party, but typing my card into some random website that isn't even the App Store feels sketchy. With no party coming up this week, I don't need the full thing yet.
objection: Paying on an unknown website with my card feels risky, and I can't tell if it's a real company or if they'll take my money and the app just stops working.
would_change_my_mind: Being able to pay through Apple Pay, Google Pay or Bit instead of typing my card in, plus seeing a TikTok of someone like me actually fooling friends with it right before a party.
